verdict.rationale: Orama ships a built-in 'AnswerSession'/Answer Engine feature that lets users ask natural-language questions and get synthesized answers with sources, described repeatedly as a 'ChatGPT-like experience' built directly into the product, with a Secure Proxy so the AI assistant runs without exposing API keys client-side. This is a genuine built-in AI assistant capability, not just a search feature, and is well documented across several doc pages. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that AnswerSession works as described, and more detail on task-delegation depth (multi-turn conversations, actions beyond Q&A).
